name: Selfie Generator
description: Generate selfie images with face reference images. cozy/glam → gpt-image-2 medium (Gemini fallback); chunyu/tease → Doubao Seedream 5.0-lite.

openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI direct API key for gpt-image-2. Used as fallback when the Azure OpenAI endpoint hits its rate limit (10 RPM). Falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY env var.

azureOpenaiApiKey.description: Azure OpenAI API key for gpt-image-2 (default cozy/glam provider). Falls back to AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY env var.

azureOpenaiEndpoint.description: Azure OpenAI base URL, e.g. https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1. Falls back to AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT or AZURE_EXISTING_AIPROJECT_ENDPOINT env vars.

azureOpenaiDeployment.description: Azure deployment name. Default: gpt-image-2-1. Falls back to AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT env var.

geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key (fallback for cozy/glam when gpt-image-2 filter trips ~10% of the time). Falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY env var.

doubaoApiKey.description: Doubao (Volcengine ARK) API key for the `chunyu` and `tease` styles. Falls back to ARK_API_KEY env var. Format: ark-xxxx.

outputDir.description: Directory to save generated images. Default: $HOME/.openclaw/media/selfies

proactiveSelfie.description: Probabilistic selfie on regular messages (not just heartbeat).

probability.description: Probability (0-1) of injecting a selfie hint per message. 0 = disabled.

useNewDispatch.description: Use the classifier/router/rescue dispatch path from the 2026-04-23 redesign. Default true. Set false to roll back to the legacy inline routing.

persona.description: Per-persona selfie taste. Rendered into the agent system prompt to shape scene authoring. Mirror of extensions/selfie/persona-config.ts PersonaSelfieConfig.

styleTags.description: Broad wardrobe taste tags the agent treats as inspirational.

wardrobeCategories.description: Structured wardrobe category menu. Agent rotates across these to avoid anchoring on one outfit.

compositionBias.description: Preferred composition / pose patterns. High-priority directive — overrides generic 3/4 mirror portrait defaults.

baselineMood.description: Default mood when the user gives no strong signal.

notes.description: Freeform persona notes for the agent.
